interpretation: Apply all R01-R15 as behavioral obligations of only the package-private pure Java decision core. A returned decision is an instruction, not proof that Android, JNI, main-Looper or cleanup effects executed. Ignore stale/foreign capabilities without adopting, replacing or closing their resources. Trusted thread checking precedes any state observation or mutation, even for stale and terminal calls.
independent_additions: Use two simultaneously live owners with distinct resources to expose identity-versus-value token errors and verify their states remain independent.
Probe exact readiness fact combinations, duplicate queued drains, retirement with matching open success and failure, completion ordering, and unavailable environment recovery.
Test every callable entry and value accessor exposed by the core with an armed trusted wrong-thread checker where applicable; snapshot unchanged state after disarming.
Distinguish candidate defects from independent harness/oracle defects; retain the first failed run artifacts and explain any harness correction before rerunning.
Inspect retained fields and all decision construction sites directly for bounded production state and per-call output, supplementing a long deterministic stress sequence.
Treat operations that never return, native effect execution, device gates and exported adapter integration as explicit pending limits.

execution_plan.independent_harness: Author a new package-peer Java main using deterministic manual callbacks and assertions; do not import or execute producer tests/runner/verifier.
execution_plan.compile: Official existing JDK; javac --release 17 -Xlint:all -Werror -proc:none; exactly candidate core source plus independent harness; empty classpath and sourcepath.
execution_plan.children: Owned compile/run subprocesses only, individually bounded to at most 180 seconds; no sleeps, Android stubs, native runtime, process inventory or UI tools.
execution_plan.evidence: Capture exact argv, tool versions, source revision and digests, input snapshots, stdout/stderr, exit statuses, coverage counts, output class digests and owned scratch cleanup.

not_authorized: hosted catalog-inspector, authority-driver, rejected WorkerV2 or broad hosted harness
